import ctypes
import numpy as np

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_function structure
class GSLFunction(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [("function", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)),
                ("params", ctypes.c_void_p)]

# Define the gsl_integration_qng function
gsl_integration_qng = gsl.gsl_integration_qng
gsl_integration_qng.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(GSLFunction), ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double), ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t)]
gsl_integration_qng.restype = ctypes.c_int

def integrate(function, a, b, epsabs, epsrel):
    """Compute the integral of the given function over [a, b] using GSL."""
    # Wrap the Python function in a ctypes-compatible callback
    c_function = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double)(function)
    gsl_function = GSLFunction(function=c_function, params=None)

    # Prepare output variables
    result = ctypes.c_double()
    abserr = ctypes.c_double()
    neval = ctypes.c_size_t()

    # Call the GSL function
    status = gsl_integration_qng(ctypes.byref(gsl_function), a, b, epsabs, epsrel, ctypes.byref(result), ctypes.byref(abserr), ctypes.byref(neval))

    if status != 0:
        raise RuntimeError(f"GSL integration failed with status code {status}")

    return result.value, abserr.value, neval.value

def assert_test():
    """Run test cases to validate the integration function."""
    # Test case 1: Integrate f(x) = x^2 over [0, 1]
    def f1(x):
        return x ** 2

    result, abserr, neval = integrate(f1, 0, 1, 1e-6, 1e-6)
    expected_result = 1 / 3
    assert np.isclose(result, expected_result, atol=1e-6), f"Test case 1 failed: {result} != {expected_result}"

    # Test case 2: Integrate f(x) = sin(x) over [0, pi]
    def f2(x):
        return np.sin(x)

    result, abserr, neval = integrate(f2, 0, np.pi, 1e-6, 1e-6)
    expected_result = 2
    assert np.isclose(result, expected_result, atol=1e-6), f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected_result}"

    # Test case 3: Integrate f(x) = exp(-x^2) over [-1, 1]
    def f3(x):
        return np.exp(-x ** 2)

    result, abserr, neval = integrate(f3, -1, 1, 1e-6, 1e-6)
    expected_result = 1.493648265624854
    assert np.isclose(result, expected_result, atol=1e-6), f"Test case 3 failed: {result} != {expected_result}"

    print("All test cases passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
